reviews.text: I really enjoy leaving my rabbit at the hotel. They always treat her very well and the people are always very friendly. I only regret that they can't send photos or videos via WhatsApp. But we can call or email and they always respond and tell us how the pet is doing. It's a relief to be on vacation knowing that our companion is well taken care of.

I want to thank Bárbara and Clara for taking care of my two children, Giba and Daisy. After a less than ideal experience at another hotel, I was very apprehensive, but everything went very well.
Thank you

Some years ago, me and my family went on vacation and we decided to left our so beloved dog with only 2 years at that time at this pet hotel. It went ok. We decided to do repeat that the next year where it all went downhill. The second year, after me and my family returned from vacation we went to pick up our dog and he looked a totally different dog. Scared when we would pet him, as if we were gonna hit him (thing that never happened), he always seemed sad and afraid we were gonna do something. its been 5y and my dog (a pug who’s really sweet) still shows some signs of fear whenever other people other than me and my family pet him. Unfortunately until this day we don’t know what happened, but please search for places that are pet friendly when you go on vacation or seek people who are trustworthy to take care of your pet, because you can never guess what happens in this type of places.

One of the best places to leave my parrot! There aren't many others we can trust!

Always happy! 😀
Next time I'll take some shots so you can see the wonderful conditions they offer for your pets.

Ohhhh, they have dogs and cats too! 😀

Not my cup of tea, but for those who like it, it seems like a fantastic place with monitors and caregivers who really care!! 😀
Always well treated!
